findings.title: The reviewed wx behavior is not selected by Bambu, and wx2 on master would reach uncorrected release branches
findings.novelty: Prior finding; closed by independently verified backward-compatible opt-in and exact separate adoption candidate.
findings.trigger: Previously, fetching wx master would eventually enable nonidentity conversion for uncorrected release applications. The current implementation requires the explicit gtk.window.font-dpi-scaling option to equal 1.
findings.outcome: Default and options-disabled conversions return identity before GTK/window access. The sampled release trees contain no opt-in. Corrected Bambu explicitly opts in early and selects an exact reachable combined wx revision. The previous default release-wide regression no longer follows from these candidates.
findings.parent_response_assessment: Accepted. Release backports or protective release pins are no longer required to preserve default behavior. The existing system-options zero accessor is sufficient; no framework or source doubles are needed in production. The separate adoption candidate is concrete rather than a warning-only gate.
findings.proof: Full wx tree equals upstream abb5426 plus exactly the five changed files from the two candidate trees; both candidate heads are ancestors. Live read-only ls-remote confirms 0f2037fa at the declared fork branch. Integration recipe/startup blobs match the combined app. Both exact release trees still fetch master but contain no option name. 51 supplied native process logs and two live archives were hash-checked; source/accessor and options-disabled 613-step build completion inspected. Live ELF disassembly was regenerated read-only and matches the saved SetOption(1)-before-on_init_inner evidence.
findings.smallest_practical_fix: Implemented: default-off system option plus tiny separate Bambu adoption draft pinned to the combined wx source. Before any later upstream integration submission, replace the temporary fork URL/SHA with the accepted official revision as the candidate body already requires.
findings.verification_needed: Closure checks completed in verification.json/commands.json. Windows/macOS and complete Studio runtime behavior remain unvalidated and must not be represented as validated; absence of those runs is not itself an open blocker.
findings.blocking_scope: No remaining blocker for the reviewed personal-fork drafts. No approval for upstream submission or all-platform readiness.

findings.title: wx1 body overstates its wrapped-label exclusion
findings.novelty: Prior wording finding; revised candidate body independently checked against source.
findings.trigger: The old description promised all wrapped static labels retained their prior path, although wxStaticText best-size measurement temporarily disables wrapping.
findings.outcome: The new sentence describes the GTK label measurement state, not an exclusion of all wxStaticText wrapping paths; it matches the implementation.
findings.parent_response_assessment: Accepted without further source or body changes.
findings.proof: Candidate body now says: The check runs while GTK measures a label without wrapping; other widget types keep their existing path. Source checks wrapping at control.cpp:356; stattext.cpp:237 disables it for measurement and :251 restores it.
findings.smallest_practical_fix: Implemented the narrow wording correction. No implementation change is required by this finding.
findings.verification_needed: Completed direct body/source comparison. No native test is necessary to verify the wording correction. Supplied direct wrapped-GTK-label exclusion probe does not establish exclusion of every wxStaticText wrapping path.

checked_commands_and_results.wx_tree_composition: Exact union of upstream abb5426 and both wx candidate changes

limitations: No builds, probe execution, GTK/Studio launch, GUI/input, installation, repository/index/branch writes, GitHub writes or delegation occurred. All reviewer writes are confined to the assigned scratch directory.
Portable Python verifies source/metadata/hash correspondence only. Existing native results were inspected rather than reproduced.
Source/body conclusions are scoped to wx1/wx2 and three Bambu dependency-chain candidates; other eleven candidates received metadata checks only.
Windows/macOS have not been compiled or run. No new GTK2/GTK4, shared-library, native Wayland, Debug or C++98 native-library validation.
Supplied build is warm with six disclosed local CMake adaptations. Supplied native probes use private Xvfb, hidden/no-frame harnesses and no Studio event loop.
Sampled two release heads rather than an exhaustive support-branch inventory. Explicit system-option environment activation is opt-in.
Historical screenshots show earlier combined Linux builds and are not final isolated-PR visual acceptance.
Temporary fork pin must become an accepted official revision before upstream submission. This review does not authorize upstream PRs or claim all-OS/complete-runtime/merge readiness.
